alerts.headline: Infosys flags intensifying pricing pressure as clients demand higher AI productivity
alerts.summary: CFO Jayesh Sanghrajka cautioned that pricing pressure would continue into the second half of the financial year, alongside the impact of employee compensation increases.

alerts.summary: Parekh said Infosys has already developed defences against some of the vulnerabilities that have emerged in recent days and is sharing these capabilities with its enterprise clients.

alerts.headline: Jio IPO sets record with many firsts for an Indian IPO: Here are 7 key milestones

alerts.headline: Infosys Q2 results: IT major's ADR falls 6% after it lowers annual revenue growth guidance
alerts.summary: In the quarterly earnings report, Infosys, India’s second-largest IT services company, revised its revenue growth guidance for FY2026-27 to 1-2 percent in constant currency terms, compared with its earlier forecast of 1.5-3 percent.

alerts.headline: JSW Steel Q2 results: Profit zooms 225% YoY at Rs 5,279 on record sales, firm flat steel prices; revenue rises 10.7%
alerts.summary: JSW Steel's consolidated profit after tax (PAT) surged 225.3 percent at Rs 5,279 crore for the quarter ended September 30, buoyed by record steel sales and firm flat steel prices offset which elevated coking coal costs.

alerts.headline: From household spending to corporate capex: Why the next leg of India’s growth may look different
alerts.summary: Listed Indian companies have pushed their return on equity to around 16 percent in FY26, up from the pre-pandemic range of 11 to 12 percent.

alerts.headline: Infosys revises FY27 revenue growth guidance between 1-2%; reduces both upper and lower end of the band
alerts.summary: Large deal total contract value (TCV) for the September quarter stood at $5.2 billion, compared with $3.6 billion in the preceding quarter. Over 60 percent of the deal value came in as net-new business.

alerts.headline: BPCL, IndiGo, Apollo Tyres, other crude-sensitive shares fall up to 4% as oil prices surge
